deep.reconstruction:
This page contains no mathematics. It is a heavily corrected pencil draft of a letter written on the back of a printed Bremen freight form ('Frachtzettel', with columns No. der Karte / Zeichen / Stück / Pfund / Loth). The addressee is almost certainly the editor of Crelle's Journal; C. W. Borchardt is my inference and is not named on the page. The letter concerns the printing of Riemann's 'Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen' (Crelle 54, 1857). Its sense, reconstructed from the image:

(1) Riemann may send 'from Göttingen' a few further additions and changes to the treatises on Abelian functions. This implies he was away from Göttingen when writing. A deleted continuation says he does not want to delay the printing.

(2) He would like, after going through his papers currently in Göttingen, to add to the introduction a note on the course of his investigations ('die Notiz über den Gang meiner Untersuchungen').

(3) He would like to add to the second treatise applications to particular cases ('Anwendung auf besondere Fälle').

(4) He asks whether the editor would permit a small woodcut in the text ('einen kleinen Holzschnitt in den Text zu gestatten'), to add a figure for illustration ('eine Figur zur Veranschaulichung'). A deleted alternative here was 'Druckfehlerberichtigung' (list of misprints).

(5) A remark about the proof correction ('Die Korrektur ... bitte ich Sie ...').

(6) Several abandoned attempts at a closing formula thanking the addressee for his kind efforts toward the publication of Riemann's works ('Für Ihre freundlichen Bemühungen um die Veröffentlichung meiner Arbeiten', 'Zum Dank und Anerkennung ...').

Context from the adjacent folios:
- The previous page drafts a remark comparing the definition of (n+1)-fold connected surfaces by cross-cuts (as in the Dissertation) with the one chosen in the Abelian-functions paper. This is plausibly material for the announced 'Zusätze'.
- The next page contains draft text on the theta-function zero theorem and constants k_mu, and a letter dated 'Göttingen 27 Mai 1857'.

There is nothing to compute or derive.

results.what: Draft of a letter to the journal editor about additions, an introductory note on the history of his investigations, applications to special cases, a woodcut figure, and proofs for the 1857 Abelian functions paper

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a non-mathematical letter draft about publishing the 1857 Abelian-functions paper. It is of modest biographical interest only: Riemann's wish for a figure (woodcut) and for a historical note in the introduction.
transcription_corrections: 'so ganz einem kleinen Notiz Schriftsatz in den Tagen zu gestatten' should read approximately 'einen kleinen Holzschnitt in den Text zu gestatten' (a small woodcut in the text), which fits the following 'eine Figur zur Veranschaulichung beizufügen'.
In the first lines, the inserted word above 'wesentliche' reads 'einige'. The crossed-out adjective may be 'unwesentliche' rather than 'wesentliche' (uncertain).

'und zu Anmerkungen der zweiten Abhandlung' is doubtful. The sense is that applications to special cases are to be added to the second treatise; a reading such as 'und zu Ende der zweiten Abhandlung' is possible.
The final line likely reads 'Zum Dank und [zur] Anerkennung Ihrer freundlichen [Bemühungen]'.
The page is written over a printed Bremen 'Frachtzettel' form. The printed headers (Zeichen, Stück, Pfund, Loth) are not part of Riemann's text.
